name: Hillcrest Energy Technologies Ltd.
summary: Hillcrest Energy Technologies Ltd. engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and production of oil and gas reserves in North America. It has an option to acquire 75% working interest in West Hazel field, a petroleum asset located in the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin, Saskatchewan. The company was formerly known as Hillcrest Petroleum Ltd. and changed its name to Hillcrest Energy Technologies Ltd. in April 2021. Hillcrest Energy Technologies Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
